title: Preallocate foreign-key parent data keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when foreign-key parent existence checks build data:<table>:<row_id> keys from known component lengths.
implementation: Added foreign_key_data_key_for_row_id() with explicit capacity for data:<table>:<row_id>.
Replaced single-column primary-key parent existence key construction.
Replaced composite primary-key parent row existence key construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Foreign-key parent data-key construction now reserves capacity from known table and row-id lengths while preserving FK enforcement behavior.
